title: Hitler to Cookie Monster in six real photos
hook: How is Hitler connected to Cookie Monster?
description: Six real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Cookie Monster: Mussolini's foreign minister Ciano, Lord Halifax, Churchill, Queen Elizabeth II and Michelle Obama.
fun_fact: In May 1940 Lord Halifax could have become Britain's prime minister, but he stepped aside and the job went to Winston Churchill.
research_note: The obvious exit, Lord Halifax's 1937 visit to Hitler's Berghof, survives only in non-free press copies, so Hitler leaves through Mussolini's foreign minister Ciano, who stood beside Halifax at the Rome opera in 1939.

links.line: In 1940, Hitler met Mussolini's foreign minister, Galeazzo Ciano, in Vienna, as Hungary joined their pact.

links.b: E. F. L. Wood, 1st Earl of Halifax
links.line: In 1939, Ciano and Britain's foreign secretary, Lord Halifax, stood side by side at the Rome opera.

links.a: E. F. L. Wood, 1st Earl of Halifax
links.line: In 1938, Halifax walked through London with Winston Churchill, his future rival for prime minister.
In 1953, Churchill was back as prime minister, serving the young Queen Elizabeth the Second.

links.line: And in 2014, Michelle Obama posed at the White House with Cookie Monster.
